cases.ownerFinding: p035 is an extraction-chunk placeholder, not a separately witnessed person. Chunk 002 (s0030–s0068) contains no Chinese sovereign surface at all (no 帝, 上, 朕, 陛下 or 太祖); the sovereign appears only as the unexpressed subject of 詔 (s0041, s0049, s0067) and 幸 (s0057) in 廣順三年 (AD 953). Its two name entries are misattributed: 太祖 is strongly-inferred from the chapter title and 帝 is cited at s0057 「八月己酉，幸南莊。」, which contains neither; both fail native assertDossierPrimaryWitness. The same reigning sovereign of the same annal year is already the established local p006 (帝 explicit at s0016 「五月己卯朔，帝御崇元殿受朝賀」, s0020, s0026), whose s0011 「戊申，幸南莊。」 is the exact parallel of s0057. The person therefore has established primary evidence; only the duplicate record lacks it. The prior accepted possible-same-as decisions treated p035 as a separate Taizu record solely through the misattributed 太祖 key.

proposedChanges.targetChoice: The chapter represents its sovereign as one local per extraction chunk: p006 (chunk 001, s0001–s0029), p035 (chunk 002), p061 (chunk 003), p081 (chunk 004), p121 (chunk 005, explicit 太祖) and p135 (chunk 006, 周太祖); accepted possible-same-as decisions already link p006 with p061 and p081. Only p035 lacks a primary witness. p006 is chosen because it is the record of the immediately preceding chunk in the same 廣順三年 annal sequence, already owns the parallel 幸南莊 act at s0011 and the explicit ruler role, and has an approved case with witnesses. This leaves p121 (named in 238 accepted resolution decisions) untouched and avoids p061, whose chunk carries the held AD 954 year defect.

held.reason: Every year context in extraction chunk 003 (s0069–s0110) is AD 954, but these units are the 9th–12th months of 廣順三年 that precede the 顯德元年 heading at s0111. s0075 「冬十月戊申朔，詔以來年正月一日有事於南郊」 places the 10th month in the year before the 顯德元年 first-month sacrifice, and s0069 「九月己卯，太子少保盧損卒」 is recorded as a 954 death. The 9th- and 10th-month rows are definitely AD 953. The 11th- and 12th-month rows belong to 廣順三年 but some days may fall in Julian January 954, so they need the date lane's conversion convention rather than an owner guess. The independent date audit approved these rows; this is outside the two identity holds and is not patched here.
